authors.name: European Court of Human Rights
authors.reason: It issues its own judgments.

authors.name: Oryx

authors.name: International Energy Agency
authors.reason: It publishes standard energy data with a clear method.

authors.name: Cipriani, Goldberg and La Spada (NY Fed staff report)

authors.name: Chupilkin, Javorcik and Plekhanov (EBRD working paper)
authors.reason: Its researchers are named and it shows its data and its method.

authors.reason: It is a price reporter with a published method.

authors.reason: It is the primary source for its own statistics.

authors.reason: It verifies each case.

authors.name: GeoConfirmed
authors.reason: It has an open method but its geolocators are volunteers.

authors.name: The Insider
authors.reason: It runs strong investigations that are often based on one source.

authors.reason: It does real reporting but repeats official claims.

authors.name: Meduza

authors.reason: It keeps a good front-line map but has ties to the army.

authors.name: Gazprom (self-report)
authors.reason: It is a company that speaks about itself under state control.

authors.name: Brookings
authors.reason: It publishes opinion and analysis with mixed sourcing.

authors.name: Rybar

authors.name: TASS
authors.reason: It gives the state line and does not correct it.

authors.name: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation
authors.reason: It has repeated false claims on the war.

authors.name: Mash
authors.reason: It is a tabloid channel with some real scoops and no corrections.

authors.name: RT
authors.reason: It is sanctioned for disinformation.

authors.name: War on Fakes

authors.name: Anonymous Telegram channel with no record
